name: Jonah
overview: The book of Jonah reveals God's sovereign call upon the prophet Jonah to warn the great city of Nineveh of its wickedness, as seen when the word of the Lord commands Jonah to arise and go to Nineveh (Jonah 1:1-2). Jonah's initial disobedience, fleeing in the opposite direction, results in divine discipline through a tempestuous storm, demonstrating God's authority over creation and judgment (Jonah 1:3-4). Despite Jonah's attempt to escape, God's purpose prevails, highlighting the seriousness of obedience and the mercy extended even to a rebellious people.
